## L007 — Why Vietnam Paid Tribute to China for Centuries (After Fighting Its Armies)

**Description**

```
Vietnamese rulers fought Chinese armies again and again between the 10th and 19th centuries, yet in many periods they also sent envoys and tribute to the Chinese court. At home they were emperors; in letters to China, kings. How did that work, what did each side think it meant, and how did it end in 1884–85?
```
